CustomField.description: One-line title of the remote issue - Jira's issue.fields.summary. This is what a person calls the task; Name is the record's auto number and External_Key__c is the remote identifier, and neither reads as a title.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Title of the work, as the external system states it. Synced; edits here are overwritten on the next inbound update.
CustomField.label: Title
